risks: This would be the first C file in overlay_49 (src/overlay_49* does not exist). MWCC -W pedantic needs local prototypes for all 55 exported functions in the .c (pattern first-chunk-decomp-needs-local-prototypes). No existing include/ header declares any of these symbols and every caller is still asm, so there is no IPA conflict. Do NOT create or modify shared headers.
Statics: ov49_0225D4FC, ov49_0225D520, ov49_0225D5FC and rodata ov49_02269A6C are absent from the .inc. The other 55 functions must stay non-static.
Jump table in ov49_0225D224: dense cases 0-6, bodies in order 0-2 / 3-4 / 5 / 6 (cases 5 and 6 are duplicate, unmerged bodies), no default.

ov49_0225D1C4 has push {r0-r3} arg-homing, which needs a by-value 4-byte struct param with &param taken. ov49_0225D1EC returns that struct by value (r0 packed). ov49_0225D098 passes it by value through the sp-4 scratch copy.
ov49_0225CB78: the inlined 0x14-byte strb clear loop must be written as memset(), not a hand loop (pattern inlined-memset-not-hand-loop).
ov49_0225D528 contains the inline NNS_G3dGetMdlByIdx expansion (two NULL checks). Use the inline from res_struct_accessor_inline.h.

NNS_G3dMdlSetMdlLightEnableFlagAll has no header, so a local extern is needed (as in src/field/model_attributes.c). NarcIds 0xCA/0xCB need NARC_a_2_0_0/NARC_a_2_0_1 or explicit casts (-W noimplicitconv).
ov49_0225CC4C has an unused 4th param (the caller deliberately loads r3). ov49_0225D5E4 has an unused 2nd param. Keep both or the callers' bytes will not match once those callers are decompiled.
CF28 asserts are signed <= (cmp #2/#3; ble), while D224/D328 use signed < and the u16 modelIdx uses unsigned blo. Choose int vs u16 accordingly.
ov49_0225D160 calls sub_020180E8 (re-init) where a free would be expected. Reproduce it as-is.
Field re-reads after stores (CB50 u8 field, D3F8 animFrame) mean the code must use the field expression, not the param.

Many functions are 2-mod-4 with .balign pads (CB68, CBDC, CBF4, CC28, CC44, CCC0, CDE8, D088, D090, D1C4, D1EC, D328, D394, D470, D4A0, D4C8, D4F0, D528, D57C, D5A0, D5E4). The last function D5FC is 4-aligned (0xB0), so the trailing-pad hazard is unlikely, but run full compare.
